notes: Research article (Micropor. Mesopor. Mater. 223 (2016) 79-88), not retracted, no statement that the H2 data were published before. Sorbents measured for H2 are C@Pd90Co10-6 and C@Pd75Co25-6: Pd-Co nanoalloy (~3.7-3.8 wt% PdCo, ~82 wt% C) in soft-templated mesoporous carbon, i.e. metal-decorated carbon (metal_element Pd/Co). H2 uptake measured only at 25 °C, by Sieverts volumetry: manual device to 9 MPa (Fig. 10a, max ~0.27 wt% near 9.1 MPa for C@Pd90Co10-6) and Autosorb IQ to 0.1 MPa (Fig. 10b); values are figure-only (no table or text values). No 77 K data. BET areas (N2, P/P0 0.05-0.3) in Table 2 are for the same samples as the H2 isotherms. In-situ XRD under 1 bar H2 (SI Fig. S6) is not an uptake measurement.
